notes.title: Update 0.1.13 ✨
notes.notes:
Oh wow, it’s been a while!

We’ve been heads-down making some foundational changes to the Cubzh engine. 
You won’t see much of this in the UI just yet, but trust us, it’s setting the stage for big things. 
Upcoming releases are about to bring you non-voxel 3D shapes with physically based rendering and an AI game maker we can’t wait to show off. 

For developers, this update switches from Lua 5.3 to Luau, the same Lua flavor powering Roblox. 
Years of optimization from the Roblox team making your games run smoother in Cubzh.
Plus, Luau brings code analysis tools that’ll soon supercharge our AI game-making plans.
It almost sounds too good to be true, right? :D

Hang tight, we’re kicking off a whole new chapter soon!

notes.title: Update 0.0.49 ✨

Hello hello, dear Cubzh community! 
0.0.49 is here at last and offers a brand new feature: [b]the Item Gallery[/b]. 🖼️ 

Currently all items made in Cubzh can be found in the Gallery. But in the future, you'll have the option to choose whether or not you want to share your art with everyone! ✨ 

[h2]0.0.49 (January 25, 2023)[/h2]

- Introducing the gallery to browse user made items! 🖼️ 
You can open it from the main menu. There's not much you can do yet besides admiring previews + copy/pasting item names (very useful if you're a dev). This section is going to evolve a lot and fast now that we laid the first brick! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38741870/d60cdfb26ae548e5c08bfdacf3f05a958c04697f.gif[/img]

[list]

[/list]
[h3]Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix keyboard input fixes
[*] A lot of bug fixes & improvements
[/list]

That's all for now!  🙌 
While the update may not have many notable changes, it lays a solid foundation for future developments, improves stability, and introduces new physics.

notes.title: Update 0.0.48 ✨
notes.notes:
Finally! 0.0.48 has arrived! 
Huge new features are incoming with it, such as a brand new main screen, friends requests and cool multiplayer games!

[h2]### 0.0.48 (December 7, 2022)[/h2]

- New main screen (this is just the beginning, general onboarding experience is about to change a lot!)
- Fixed a lot of memory leaks, crashes and other bugs 🛠️ 

[h3]Players[/h3]
[list]

[*] You can now share game links (tell your friends to open them in Chrome, Firefox or Edge) 🌐

[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38741870/115e15aa3750a8e041a80caaaaa4810100aa5b4f.png[/img]

[h3]Item Editor[/h3]
[list]
[*]We had to remove a few features (mirror, import, export, mode to place items on avatar). It's all coming back through quick patch updates over the coming days.⚠️ 
[*]"Select" mode enabling items made out of multiple shapes will also be unlocked through one of these patch updates. This big feature is the reason why we had to rework a lot of things, down to our file format.
[/list]

[h3]Coders[/h3]
[list]
[*] New Text API to create texts in both World & Screen spaces 📚 
[*] Script modules are becoming a thing. You still can't submit your own, but we'll document the ones shipped with the application (multi, plane, particles, polygonbuilder, etc.). You can already prepare your modules following the same model.
[/list]
